fn sql_type_name(ty: &Type) -> &'static str {
    match ty {
        Type::Int => "INTEGER",
        Type::Bool => "BOOLEAN",
        Type::Text => "TEXT",
        Type::Float => "FLOAT",
        Type::Jsonb => "JSONB",
        Type::Uuid => "UUID",
        Type::DateTime => "TIMESTAMP",
        Type::Option(inner) => sql_type_name(inner),
        Type::Vec(inner) => format!("VECTOR({})", sql_type_name(inner)).as_str(),
        Type::Join => "JOIN",
        _ => "UNKNOWN",
    }
}
